# @haruhimemoe/ui

> React components for the haruhime.moe osu! tools on Next.js 16 (app router), React 19 and Tailwind CSS 4.1+. It ships the osu!-web-style palette as a Tailwind theme (`@haruhimemoe/ui/theme.css`, colors `b1`-`b6`, `c1`-`c4`, `h1`, `h2` from one `--hue`), plus buttons, links, badges, form fields, inline and type-to-confirm confirms, a character counter, a visibility picker, a report form, in-page tabs, filter controls (chips, choice chips, a two-thumb range slider, a filter panel), tables, osu! display pieces (star rating, beatmap stats, mod badges), a command palette (mod+k), MDX components with Shiki code highlighting and a remark plugin (`@haruhimemoe/ui/mdx`, `@haruhimemoe/ui/remark`, `@haruhimemoe/ui/shiki`), and the site header, footer, link tabs, account menu and page frame. ESM only. Most components are Server Components; the client ones carry `"use client"` in their own files, so everything imports from `@haruhimemoe/ui`. MIT license.

The README describes version 0.8.0 and marks what each earlier version lacks with "since x.y.0". An app sets it up by loading Tailwind through `@tailwindcss/postcss`, adding `@import "@haruhimemoe/ui/theme.css";` after `@import "tailwindcss";`, and loading Nunito from `next/font` as the `--font-nunito` variable (without it, the system font).

## Docs

- [Requirements](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui#requirements): the Next.js, React, Tailwind and Node.js versions
- [Install](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui#install): the package and its peer dependencies
- [Setup](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui#setup): PostCSS, the theme import, Nunito, and picking a hue with the `--h1-l` and `--h2-l` contrast fixes
- [Example](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui#example): a root layout with PageShell, SiteHeader and SiteFooter, and a page
- [Server and client components](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui#server-and-client-components): which components are client ones, which navs hydrate, and where callback props must come from
- [Props, classes and refs](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui#props-classes-and-refs): native props, `ref`, and how `className` merges
- [Basics](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui#basics): Button, ButtonLink, buttonClasses, Card, PageHeader, Notice, Prose, Disclosure, TextLink, linkClasses, Badge, Tabs (an ARIA tablist for in-page panels) with tabId and tabPanelId
- [Forms](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui#forms): TextInput, Textarea, Select, Checkbox, RadioGroup, TypeToConfirm (type a name to enable a destructive action), CharCounter, VisibilitySelect (private, unlisted or public as radios or a select), ReportDisclosure (a report reason form in a disclosure), fieldClasses and the shared field props
- [Actions](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui#actions): CopyButton, Pagination (links, or buttons with an unknown page count), AsyncButton, InlineConfirm (a two-step confirm with focus handling)
- [Icons](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui#icons): DiscordIcon, GitHubIcon, HaruhimeWordmark, HaruhimeWordmarkLink
- [Filters](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui#filters): Chip (with a focusable unavailable state), ChipGroup, ChoiceChips (single-select radio chips), RangeSlider, FilterRow, FilterPanel, with a client example
- [Meta](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui#meta): JsonLd, schema.org data in an escaped script tag
- [Shell](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui#shell): SiteLinkItem, SiteHeader, NavLinks, SiteFooter (with the "haruhime tools" column: HARUHIME_TOOLS, haruhimeToolsColumn), LinkTabs, HeaderMenu (account disclosure menu), PageShell
- [osu!](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui#osu): StarRating (spectrum-colored pill), BeatmapStats (CS/AR/OD/HP/BPM/length), ModBadge (slot pill by mod bucket)
- [MDX](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui#mdx-server): mdxComponents, CodeBlock (Shiki highlighting, opt-in via `@haruhimemoe/ui/shiki`), Callout (GitHub-style `[!NOTE]`/`[!TIP]`/`[!WARNING]` blockquotes too), parseCodeMeta, slugify, and the `@haruhimemoe/ui/remark` plugin (remarkHaruhime, remarkCodeMeta, remarkCallouts, remarkHeadingIds)
- [Palette](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui#palette-client): CommandPalette (mod+k, fuzzy search, nested pages, async providers, argument prompts, recents, a calculator), Command and Provider, openCommandPalette, CommandPaletteButton, siteCommands (the defaults every tool gets), fuzzyScore, evaluate and formatResult
- [Tables](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui#tables): Table, THead, TBody, Th, Td, the apps' data table look with a caption
- [Utilities](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui#utilities): cx, the tailwind-merge class merger the components use
- [Accessibility](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui#accessibility): what the components do for screen readers, keyboards and forced colors
- [Compatibility](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui#compatibility): supported versions and module format

## Source

- [src/index.ts](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui/blob/main/src/index.ts): every public export and type
- [src/theme.css](https://github.com/haruhimemoe/ui/blob/main/src/theme.css): the theme as it ships
